## All Sessions

::: {.section-intro}
Each session page includes a session overview, learning objectives and a session outline. In addition, materials, preparation tasks & learning activities are available.

The core of each session are a PowerPoint slide deck and a detailed background reading providing further information.

**Recommendations for facilitation** guide partner institutions on how to adapt examples and case studies to their regional context.
